source.title: Milling scam — original author's follow-up on changing pigment rank by removing the Silver Tongue's Quill

quote: I took of my Silver Tongue's Quill, and now I'm able to get the same amount of R1 pigments using R1 mycobloom.
notes: Original 2024 Mycobloom author explicitly reports R1 Mycobloom producing R1 pigment after removing the Silver Tongue's Quill (a profession-skill change); their higher-skill state had produced R2 pigment from R1 Mycobloom. Independently identify R1 Nacreous Pigment as item 222618 from https://goldcap.gg/retail/us/items/222618 . This advances input-rank/output-rank identity for 210796 -> 222618; previous source-backed Method records had input rank unspecified. The post gives no independent R1-pigment completed cast denominator, quantity histogram, zero outcomes, skill number, Resourcefulness/refund basis, build or date of the equipment test. Their illustrative 100-herb quantities and their prior R2-pigment averages are NOT an additional measured cohort. Historical 2024 reference-only, never estimator eligible; do not double count reddit 1fdmzwy earlier R2-pigment average records.
skill: Exact skill unknown; removing Silver Tongue's Quill reduced skill enough to produce R1 pigment rather than R2 from R1 herb
